limitations: Coverage starts at v4 independent reservation. A complete preview/import/coverage proof for pre-v4 SQL history remains next task.
SQL/file commit is not atomic: a crash can preserve checking rather than a known historical result; it still prevents UUID reuse.
No automatic terminal resolution of cross-generation unknown intents, deletion acknowledgement or cleanup-token unlock.
Only owned schema dump/restore, controlled artifacts, protocol-marker fixtures and current API callbacks were tested; not production whole-system recovery or real old deployed binaries.
Private SHA256 integrity is not an external signature against an owner who can replace the maintenance root. Whole-volume rollback/host loss requires independent backup.
No daily/production deployment, old executor handoff, permanent S3/OSS target or 7/14 day acceptance.
